title: Youthful Yellow Vietnamese Beef Pho Bo
description: A spicy and energizing Vietnamese dish featuring chili powder and ferment-jang, this flexitarian-friendly pho bo is perfect for a nourishing meal.
instructions: In a large pot, combine beef broth, chili powder, ferment-jang, ginger, onion, and star anise, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add beef strips to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, or until cooked through.
Cook rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Strain the broth and discard solids.
Add fish sauce to the broth and stir to combine.
Assemble the pho bo by placing noodles in a bowl, adding sliced beef, and ladling hot broth over the top.
Serve with lime wedges on the side.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
